sections.heading: Siddhartha Law vs Uttaranchal University for LLB: which is better in 2026
paragraphs: Choose Siddhartha Law College if you want the recorded year tuition of ₹67,266.67 for LLB, after you confirm the official notice, because that figure looks like a stored average rather than a rounded official fee.
Choose Uttaranchal University if you want the recorded LLB (Hons) year tuition of ₹1,41,800, after official confirmation.

sections.heading: Fees: what our records show, and what to watch
paragraphs: For Siddhartha Law College we hold year tuition of ₹67,266.67 for Bachelor of Legislative Law (LLB). The paise in that figure are unusual, so treat it as a recorded row and confirm the official circular before you budget.
For Uttaranchal University we hold year tuition of ₹1,41,800 for LLB (Hons). That is a year figure, not a confirmed official three-year total, and we have not multiplied it.
Confirm the current notices on the official Siddhartha Law College and uttaranchaluniversity.ac.in pages.

Ask both campuses for an official internship or placement note if outcomes are central to your decision.

sections.heading: Admission, ranks and eligibility

sections.heading: Location and campus
paragraphs: Both are recorded in Dehradun, Uttarakhand, as private institutions, so a local student can visit them on the same trip.
The Uttaranchal University programme is recorded as LLB (Hons). Siddhartha Law College is recorded as LLB. Confirm the exact degree name on the official prospectus.

sections.heading: Verdict: who should pick which college
paragraphs: Pick Siddhartha Law College if that campus and the lower recorded year tuition fit you, after you have a written official fee rather than our ₹67,266.67 row alone.
Pick Uttaranchal University if the LLB (Hons) programme and that campus are the goal, after official fee confirmation.
This page has no placement or rank data to break the tie.
